title: Switch Valentine slideshow to 11-page cute boy-with-glasses love story flow

requirements.summary: Restructure slideshow controller from 9 screens to an 11-page flow with consistent transitions and preserved onUserInteraction behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The slideshow controller advances through exactly 11 pages (not counting the pre-intro overlay), and does not stop at 9.
All existing per-page transition timing behavior remains smooth and consistent with current transitions.
The slideshow still calls the provided onUserInteraction callback on any user-driven advance or answer so music autoplay gating continues to work.

file_operations.description: Update the slideshow state machine to support 11 pages (cap navigation at 11), render the new Page 10 and Page 11 screens, and preserve the existing transition timing + onUserInteraction call on user-driven advances.
Add a dedicated Page 10 screen that hosts the full animated story sequence (long-distance → love → marriage → family with 5 children) and provides navigation onward in the 11-page flow.
Add a dedicated Page 11 closing screen with the required final greeting text and an editable last-note box, wired as the final slideshow page.

requirements.summary: Update Page 1 welcome copy to “HEY JAAN ❤️” with a Continue button.
acceptanceCriteria: Page 1 displays the text exactly “HEY JAAN ❤️”.
A visible Continue button advances to Page 2.

file_operations.description: Replace the existing Page 1 greeting text with the exact uppercase copy “HEY JAAN ❤️” and keep the Continue button advancing to the next page.

requirements.summary: Keep Page 2 as a fading romantic message with a Continue button.
acceptanceCriteria: The Page 2 message fades in after page load (or after a short delay) and matches the text exactly.
Continue advances to Page 3.

file_operations.description: Ensure the Page 2 message text matches exactly “You make my world brighter every day… and I want to ask you something special.” and preserves the existing fade-in timing behavior with a Continue button to proceed.

requirements.summary: Update Page 3 Valentine question to cute boy-with-glasses theme with NO attempt behavior and YES celebration overlay (hearts+stars+moon).
acceptanceCriteria: The question remains exactly “Will you be my Valentine?” with the two buttons “👉 YES 💖” and “👉 NO 😠”.
First NO shows the angry boy-with-glasses animation + the exact text “Wrong answer! Try again 😤”, then returns to the question automatically.
Second NO fades out and becomes unclickable/disabled.
YES triggers a celebratory overlay that includes hearts plus star and moon elements before advancing to Page 4.

file_operations.description: Swap bunny/panda visuals for the angry boy-with-glasses image, update the first-NO message to exactly “Wrong answer! Try again 😤”, preserve the two-button question state and second-NO fade/disable behavior, and trigger a celebration overlay on YES that includes hearts plus star and moon elements before advancing.
Create a reduced-motion-aware celebratory overlay effect that includes hearts plus star and moon elements, for use on Page 3 acceptance.
Add the generated static asset for the Page 3 angry boy-with-glasses visual at frontend/public/assets/generated/boy-glasses-angry.dim_800x800.png.

requirements.summary: Update Page 4 to happy dancing boy-with-glasses with exact text and sparkly Continue button.
acceptanceCriteria: Page 4 uses boy-with-glasses imagery and no bunny/panda references in visuals or alt text.
The displayed sentence matches exactly “You just made me the happiest person alive!  💞”.
Continue button is present and includes sparkly styling/animation.

file_operations.description: Replace bunny/panda imagery and alt text with the happy dancing boy-with-glasses asset, update the displayed sentence to match exactly “You just made me the happiest person alive!  💞” (including the double space), and keep the sparkly-styled Continue button behavior.
Add the generated static asset for the Page 4 happy dancing boy-with-glasses visual at frontend/public/assets/generated/boy-glasses-happy-dance.dim_800x800.png.

requirements.summary: Keep Page 5 as a 6-letter gallery with photo paste placeholders, ordered captions, editable notes, and Continue ❤️.
acceptanceCriteria: There are exactly 6 letter cards, each opens on click with a cute opening animation and floating hearts.
Each opened letter contains a pasteable photo area and a notes input/textarea.
Captions match the specified text exactly and are shown in the specified order.
A “Continue ❤️” button advances to Page 6.

file_operations.description: Verify Page 5 remains exactly 6 letter cards with the required caption texts in the required order, retains photo-paste placeholders and editable notes, and keeps the “Continue ❤️” navigation to Page 6.
Verify the opened letter view includes the pasteable photo area, editable notes box, and floating hearts effect; adjust only as needed to meet the Page 5 interaction/animation acceptance criteria.

requirements.summary: Update Page 6 Kiss screen to boy-with-glasses theme with exact fade-in text, heart particles, and Continue.
acceptanceCriteria: Boy-with-glasses kiss imagery is used (no bunny/panda).
Text matches exactly “If I could, I’d kiss you a thousand times right now 💋 ”.
Soft heart particle background is visible (with reduced-motion fallback preserved).
Continue advances to Page 7.

file_operations.description: Replace bunny/panda imagery and alt text with the boy-with-glasses blowing-kisses asset, update the fading text to match exactly “If I could, I’d kiss you a thousand times right now 💋 ” (including trailing space), and keep the HeartParticleField background respecting reduced motion.
Add the generated static asset for the Page 6 boy-with-glasses kiss visual at frontend/public/assets/generated/boy-glasses-kiss.dim_800x800.png.

requirements.summary: Update Page 7 Proposal screen to boy-with-glasses theme with exact question text and two affirmative buttons only.
acceptanceCriteria: The proposal text matches exactly “Will you marry me in future? 💍”.
Only two buttons are shown: “👉 Of course ❤️” and “👉 Always ❤️”; no negative option exists.
On selection, a celebration accent plays briefly, then navigation proceeds to Page 8.

file_operations.description: Replace bunny/panda imagery and alt text with the boy-with-glasses proposal asset, update proposal question text to exactly “Will you marry me in future? 💍”, render exactly two affirmative buttons labeled “👉 Of course ❤️” and “👉 Always ❤️”, and play a brief celebration accent before advancing.
Add the generated static asset for the Page 7 boy-with-glasses proposal visual at frontend/public/assets/generated/boy-glasses-proposal.dim_800x800.png.

requirements.summary: Keep Page 8 moonrise envelope reveal with editable letter content and Continue.
acceptanceCriteria: A moonrise scene appears, the envelope opens, and a letter emerges.
The letter contains an editable text area.
Continue advances to Page 9.

file_operations.description: Preserve the moonrise envelope/letter reveal sequence and ensure the letter remains editable; verify the Continue button advances to the next page in the updated 11-page flow.

requirements.summary: Refactor the former final page into Page 9 Custom Message with boy-with-glasses animation, labeled glowing text box, floating hearts, and exact “Forever yours.” line.
acceptanceCriteria: Page 9 shows a boy-with-glasses visual element/animation.
The heading/label is exactly “My message to you…”.
The ending line is exactly “Forever yours.” (no additional emoji).
The Love Story animation content is not shown on Page 9 (it is moved to Page 10).

file_operations.description: Refactor this screen to be Page 9 only: include a boy-with-glasses visual using frontend/public/assets/generated/boy-glasses-final.dim_800x800.png, keep the label exactly “My message to you…”, keep a glowing editable text box, add floating hearts, and change the ending line to exactly “Forever yours.” while removing the embedded LoveStoryAnimation section from this page.
Add the generated static asset for the Page 9 boy-with-glasses custom message visual at frontend/public/assets/generated/boy-glasses-final.dim_800x800.png.

acceptanceCriteria: Page 10 exists as its own page in the slideshow after Page 9.
The story sequence clearly includes a family outcome that corresponds to 5 children.
When prefers-reduced-motion is enabled, the story does not auto-advance (manual navigation is still possible).
